title: Get Aggregator Working End to End
description: Get aggregator working end to end. Currently no windows show content. Error: Fehlendes Fenster: puzzle3d-main-perspective
summary:
Fixed empty aggregator panes (missing-window race + blank WebGL).

Missing body: seed default-layout extras/shell layout on session create; keep extraWindowInstancesRef authoritative for refreshUi so concurrent boot refresh cannot wipe instance-keyed window UI.

Blank canvases: sticky peekPendingWorldProjection (clear on pane close only); layout effects use live store camera via getThree() + isOrthographicCamera duck-typing so Top gets pixel frustum; demand frameloop invalidates after reference/GLB load plus a short mount pump.

Verified Playwright on :6023 — Top shows floor plan/grid/markers; Perspective shows reference plane + GLB mesh.
